interpretation: Apple documents per-file fsync and a drive-buffer flush through F_FULLFSYNC. Inference under test: after each regular file on one APFS st_dev finishes POSIX fsync, one final F_FULLFSYNC can serve that prepared group. Successful calls and fixture checks are not a power-loss, filesystem-topology or hardware-equivalence proof.
decision: No production implementation selected. Admission before writes yields a substantial concurrent-only diagnostic gain but single-request/cold behavior is not improved and full resource gates remain unqualified. A native owner would require explicit lifecycle, portability, distribution and complete artifact identity contracts, plus durability review and adverse testing. Preserve raw storage and current runtime until those requirements are met.
